name: cicd
description: CI/CD: white-box + grey-box results of every project (virtualpytest, sample-app, …) from the dedicated `cicd` schema, the CI/CD Reports page under Test → Report, the Run CI/CD page under Test → Execute (GitHub workflow_dispatch on a self-hosted LAN runner or a GitHub-hosted cloud runner), the /server/cicd API and the 'CI/CD Quality' Grafana dashboard. Black-box device runs stay in the core VirtualPyTest tables.
